title: Buddy Petit and the cabaret jobs: Poodle Dog and the 25
summary: Francis names the leading bands, his first cabaret job after Petit, and the Poodle Dog and the 25 club.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Now Buddy Petit, well, he's time that, had about five. Buddy Petit, Chris Kelly, Rene, Sam Morgan. Yeah, they had the town.
You mentioned something about you worked with Buddy Petit, that's when you gave up your other job.
Yeah, first band I played in the cabaret, after I left Joe. Joe was watching them. I was playing the Poodle Dog, or Liberty and Biamma.
The Poodle Dog used to call it. Yeah, I never knew that Poodle Dog.
They had a bunch of them. 101 rank, they had a few clothes, rice, grocery, right where Krause is. Oh yes, right there. And that Krause was 25, they used bands there too.
I remember the 25. Yeah. Did you ever have bands in the 25 then? I thought it was mostly a gambling place. There was a gambling in the back, they had bands there too.

Did they have any dancing or what they played for? They had some good fellows there, like this fella, Albert Cal, I don't know much about him. Oh, piano players. Yeah, Albert Cal, Wade Martin, yeah. The great fella they had there. Used to come in with such a big town, you know.
Yeah. I was reading a little book here about the district.
This book I was reading. Show you all them fans houses too, yeah.
